title: Seasia Infotech
description:
seasiainfotech.com zoominfo.com/c/seasia-infotech/353879170 Seasia Infotech — global IT services company, founded in 2000 in California, USA.
Delivery centers in India (Mohali/Chandigarh); offices in UK, Australia, UAE, Canada.
25+ years in business; completed 50,000+ projects in 36+ countries for 500+ clients.
Clients include HP, Harley-Davidson, Mahindra, Flipkart, Adani, NEC, Canon.
Holds CMMI Level 5 — the highest software process certification; also ISO 27001 and Microsoft Gold.
Services: custom software, web/mobile apps, AI & Generative AI, cloud, cybersecurity, QA, UI/UX.
2026 focus: "AI Pods" — ready-made expert teams with AI tools for HealthTech, FinTech, LegalTech.
Scale: ~300–680 employees, est. revenue $100–150M, fully bootstrapped — no external funding.
Risks: shrinking headcount (-9% YoY), unaudited revenue figures, too small for giant enterprise deals.
